title: Engine list
description: Proposed. The engines registered with the backend: each engine id an adapter serves, whether its adapter is available, and what it declares. An engine is added by installing a distribution that registers an adapter; nothing else in the SDK names it.

items.description: One entry per registered engine, sorted by engine id.

engine_id.description: The engine id a run spec names in `descriptor.origin.engine`.

available.description: Whether the adapter loaded: an unavailable engine is listed with the reason, and a run naming it is refused at admission.

adapter_version.description: The adapter's version, or null when it did not load.

modes.description: The engine-block modes the adapter serves, for example `layered` and `passthrough`; empty when it did not load.

contracts.description: The engine-block contracts the adapter reads, for example `dirsig-engine/1`; empty when it did not load.

reason.description: Why the engine is unavailable, or null.

source.description: The distribution that registered the adapter, as the backend identifies it, or null.

resources.description: The resource slots the adapter declares for a run (proposed: CPU threads, memory, GPUs, scratch space, network, assets, an external interpreter), or null when it declares none or did not load.

assets.description: The external assets the adapter requires, each named with its library reference and content digest (proposed); empty when it requires none.

schemas.description: Proposed. Every engine-block schema the engine contributes, so a client in any language can fetch it and apply it as admission does: the run-spec schema alone leaves the engine block open and is not sufficient for admission. Empty when the adapter did not load.

schema_id.description: The schema's `$id`, an absolute URI under the contract base `https://schemas.manifold.example/contracts/`, which does not resolve on the network.

location.description: Where the schema is published, relative to the contracts repository: `manifold_contracts/<file>`, the base of `schema_id` mapped to that folder; null for an id outside the base (not published).

sha256.description: The sha256 of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the schema the adapter applies, so a fetched copy can be checked against it.
